user.title: Connect Nuvio catalogs
user.description: Enter one Stremio-compatible addon manifest URL per line.

data_description.package_name: Use com.nuvio.app for Play Store builds or com.nuvio.tv for most GitHub/sideload builds.
data_description.profile_id: Profile 1 is the primary profile. Use 2–5 for another profile.
data_description.connect_account: Adds Continue Watching, My Library, profiles, and synchronized addons.
data_description.debrid_provider: Optional. With a linked Nuvio account, Home Assistant automatically uses supported debrid credentials synced for the profile. Select a provider here only as a local override.
data_description.debrid_api_key: Optional when your Nuvio account already has synced debrid. Stored only in Home Assistant when provided.
data_description.streaming_providers: Choose the WatchHub providers you want to show. The list includes a broad provider catalog, providers discovered from your synced Nuvio Streaming collection, and also lets you type a provider that is not listed. Leave it empty to show all.
data_description.watchhub_country: Filters WatchHub availability to the selected country. Defaults to the country configured in Home Assistant.
data_description.tmdb_access_token: Optional. Enables the available-provider row using TMDB/JustWatch data. It uses the same country and streaming-provider selections above.
data_description.tvdb_api_key: Optional but recommended. Resolves movie/episode remote IDs and exact provider links from TheTVDB.
data_description.tvdb_subscriber_pin: Optional. Use it when your TheTVDB API key requires a subscriber PIN.
data_description.connect_justwatch_account: Use your JustWatch session for provider-offer queries. Renewable tokens are stored; your password is not saved.
data_description.justwatch_email: Your JustWatch account email. Required with the password for one-time sign-in.
data_description.justwatch_password: Used only to create a renewable JustWatch session and is not stored in Home Assistant.
data_description.justwatch_access_token: Alternative for Google/Apple sign-in accounts: paste the browser's current access_token. It may expire if no refresh token is available.

reconfigure.title: Nuvio account
reconfigure.description: Connect, reconnect, or disconnect your Nuvio account and select the profile used by Home Assistant.

data_description.profile_id: Profile 1 is the primary profile. Use 2–5 for another profile.
data_description.connect_account: Turn this off to disconnect the currently linked Nuvio account.
data_description.debrid_provider: Optional: use Nuvio-account synced credentials automatically, or select a provider as a local override.
data_description.debrid_api_key: Leave blank to use Nuvio-synced credentials or keep an existing local override.
data_description.package_name: Use com.nuvio.tv for the normal full app, or com.nuviodebug.com for the fork test build that supports exact Home Assistant player launches.
data_description.streaming_providers: Choose the WatchHub providers you want to show. The list includes a broad provider catalog, providers discovered from your synced Nuvio Streaming collection, and also lets you type a provider that is not listed. Leave it empty to show all.

data_description.tmdb_access_token: Optional. Enables the available-provider row using TMDB/JustWatch data. It uses the same country and streaming-provider selections above.
data_description.tvdb_api_key: Optional but recommended. Resolves movie/episode remote IDs and exact provider links from TheTVDB.
data_description.tvdb_subscriber_pin: Optional. Use it when your TheTVDB API key requires a subscriber PIN.
data_description.connect_justwatch_account: Use your JustWatch session for provider-offer queries. Renewable tokens are stored; your password is not saved.

data_description.justwatch_password: Used only to create a renewable JustWatch session and is not stored in Home Assistant.

device.title: Authorize Nuvio
device.description: Scan the QR code or open [Nuvio authorization]({url}), approve code **{code}**, then return here and select **Submit**.

error.cannot_connect: Could not load any addon manifest
error.invalid_url: Enter at least one valid http or https manifest URL
error.login_start_failed: Could not start Nuvio account authorization
error.login_pending: Nuvio has not approved this code yet. Authorize it and try Continue again.
error.login_connection_failed: Could not check the Nuvio authorization. Check the connection and try again.
error.debrid_key_required: Enter an API key/token for the selected debrid provider.
error.tmdb_token_invalid: TMDB rejected the access token. Use a valid API Read Access Token.
error.tvdb_credentials_invalid: TheTVDB rejected the API key or subscriber PIN.
error.justwatch_credentials_invalid: JustWatch rejected the credentials or token. Check the account and try again.
